<thought>The mass spectrum shows a protonated molecular ion at m/z 235.139 ≈ [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of ~234.132 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 16 % of base) matches a formula with about 14 carbons (14 × 1.1 % ≈ 15 %). The formula C₁₄H₁₈O₃ has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 234.1256 Da, within a few millidaltons of the observed neutral mass, and predicts an M+1 intensity (~15.5 %) consistent with the data. No other common elements are indicated, so the most plausible molecular formula is C₁₄H₁₈O₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O3</final_answer>
